acceptanceCriteria: A real Corvint change (not a fixture checkout) produces a sealed cem/1.0 map whose runnerReceipts admit receipts from the Go runner and at least one non-Go runner profile, with the receipts retained by digest
That change is planned, claimed, reviewed, gated through cem-verdict, integrated and completed natively; the build-log entry binds every observation to exact artifact digests
A follow-up commit that changes the bound source is reported as drifted or stale by both consumers, with the result retained
Any runner or platform tuple that cannot run stays a recorded limit, never a pass
body: Found by the V1-0595 closeout audit (2026-10-21, origin/main ef2a01db5; docs/build-log/2026-10-21-v1-0595-closeout.md). V1-0596 criterion 1 needs a real compiled, non-fixture Tasks lifecycle with mixed-language CEM test evidence through plan, review, gate, integration, completion and follow-up drift. Delivered: TestCEMV1286TasksRunnerProducerVerifyChain (internal/cemchain, CEM-V1-280..287, V1-0632) runs built corvint, corvint-tasks, corvint-test-runner and cem01-go, but in a disposable fixture checkout with go test only; the production cem-verdict Tasks gate closes real tickets but every committed map has runnerReceipts []. Expected: at least one real Corvint change whose sealed cem/1.0 map admits runner receipts from Go and at least one non-Go runner profile, closed through the native cem-verdict gate, then a follow-up commit that drifts the bound source and is reported stale. Actual: no such map exists (jq .runnerReceipts over .corvint/changes/*.cem.json gives [] for 1196 of 1196). Dedupe: searched OPEN tickets for mixed-language, non-fixture, follow-up drift and cem-verdict; V1-2018 covers historical-versus-current authority in the fixture chain only; V1-1761 covers verifier build skew.
title: CEM 1.0 qualification: no real (non-fixture) Tasks lifecycle carries mixed-language runner evidence; all 1196 committed maps have empty runnerReceipts
